invalidSourceEvidence.tool-choice-required-request: Pinned SimpleStreamOptions.toolChoice accepts only auto or none; required must be exercised through a protocol-specific stream oracle.

statusDefinitions.covered: Every listed protocol has an executable pinned-source oracle case for every branch variant.
statusDefinitions.uncovered: The branch is representable but executable source-derived evidence is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.blocked: The canonical request seam cannot represent the upstream input without a recorded seam or policy change.

expressibilityDefinitions.providerRequest: The canonical ProviderRequest DTO represents the input directly.
expressibilityDefinitions.context: The input is represented by WireProtocolContext, model compatibility, or credential state rather than ProviderRequest.
expressibilityDefinitions.unsupported: The current canonical seam cannot represent the upstream input.
expressibilityDefinitions.notComparableInput: The Swift and pinned TypeScript input domains differ and no approved canonical mapping exists.

branches.expected: The caller-assembled current system prompt is emitted in the protocol-owned location.
Text and base64 image inputs preserve order, MIME type, and bytes.
Replay metadata is retained only for compatible source identity; aborted assistant output is excluded.
Opaque replay identity and signatures round-trip for the same source and are lowered or dropped for foreign sources.
Tool results preserve call identity, error status, supported images, grouping, and explicit orphan closure.
The exact source-derived protocol schema conversion is compared, including a root-ref regression case.
Strict schema transformation or explicit failure matches model capability and preference.
Grammar tools use the selected grammar or fail explicitly for invalid required inputs.
Deferred definitions are omitted initially and loaded exactly once at the transcript load point.
The pinned SimpleStreamOptions contract accepts only auto or none; omission keeps protocol defaults.
Advanced choices are proven through protocol-specific stream inputs, not by passing invalid values through streamSimple.
Reasoning mode, effort mapping, disabled representation, and unsupported mapping are explicit.
At the pinned streamSimple boundary disabled reasoning is represented by omission; any explicit wire-level disabled form needs a protocol-specific stream fixture.
Custom and default budgets are clamped without consuming all answer tokens.
Cache markers, retention, and affinity keys follow protocol/model capability.
Named generation options are emitted only when applicable.
Provider sampling parameters are applied after named generation fields and therefore win on collisions.
Credential-specific headers, identity system text, and tool casing match pinned source.
Compatibility flags alter beta headers, tool fields, cache markers, and temperature omission.
Model family selects adaptive output_config or budget thinking and preserves explicit display.
The upstream fallback branch must be explicitly rejected or adopted by policy; it must not be silently omitted.
Every compatibility flag changes the observable request exactly as pinned source.
Each mutually exclusive thinking format emits its provider-specific shape and mapped effort.
Routing preferences and provider-compatible cache markers are source-equivalent.
Response item identity, signatures, namespaces, and outputs follow source identity rules.
Cache and reasoning defaults follow compatibility and provider identity.
Azure endpoint, API version, and deployment resolution are deterministic or fail explicitly.
Codex defaults and session-affinity request fields match pinned source.
Google replay identity, function response grouping, and model-family image placement match source.
Thinking level/budget encoding follows exact model family.
Schema field and validated calling mode follow model/API capability.

unreachableSourceBranches.openapi-sanitized: Pinned Google and Vertex adapters always call convertTools with useOpenAPISchema=false.

branches.expected: Vertex auth/config resolution is deterministic and missing configuration fails before transport.
Image handling, reasoning option, and prompt-cache key follow model capability.
The complete canonical context and options survive serialization; debug affects only the query.
Bedrock cache points and reasoning replay follow model family and signature validity.
Additional model fields and Bedrock toolChoice follow exact model, region, and options.
Provider session identifiers use the exact provider-specific header names and remain request scoped.
vLLM priority is forwarded exactly and unsupported Responses output limits are omitted.
Image inputs become data URLs in order and modalities follow ImagesModel output capability.
